traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md specifies an ESLint rule that enforces @story/@req annotations on significant code branches, with requirements for branch detection, comment association, annotation parsing, nested handling, configurable scope, and performance.
The implementation provides: - A dedicated rule (src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts) with proper ESLint meta, fixers, and handlers for all relevant branch node types. - Helper utilities (src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts) that map comments to branches (including SwitchCase, CatchClause, and else-if special cases), parse annotations from comments, compute auto-fix insertion positions compatible with formatters like Prettier, and validate/configure which branch types are enforced. - Comprehensive tests that exercise valid/invalid scenarios across if/else, loops, switch, try/catch, nested branches, configurable branchTypes (including invalid configuration errors), and performance on large nested-branch files. - Rule documentation with examples and configuration guidance in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md. - Integration into the plugin’s exported rules and recommended/strict presets.
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are met and verified by passing automated tests and documentation, so the story is fully implemented.
